title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab Enterprise Edition versions from 19.2 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to enable Amazon Q automatic code reviews on projects despite administrator locks. This occurred due to improper enforcement of instance-level settings. The issue has been remediated in versions 19.3.9, 19.4.8, and 19.5.6.
